facts.subject_label: IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures :: IFRS S2 strategy disclosure
facts.source_title: Applying IFRS S1 when reporting only climate-related disclosures under IFRS S2
facts.key_requirement: Company must refer to and consider applicability of industry-based metrics associated with disclosure topics in Industry-based Guidance on implementing Climate-related Disclosures—IFRS S2.
facts.scope_definition: IFRS S2 includes specific corresponding requirements for climate-related disclosures on the topics; IFRS S1 paragraphs replicated in IFRS S2 or addressed in Table 1 apply to identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
facts.metric_integration: Metrics include climate change, jurisdictional commitments, GHG emissions targets, fuel economy of fleet, sales of zero-emission vehicles, physical risks, Scope 3 GHG emissions.
